title: Umnikelo Owaguqula Ikamva
intro: Kwimihla yokuqala yoluntu, umphefumlo wawunikela ngesipho ngeenjongo ezimsulwa. Sekunjalo, umona wawufihlakele emthunzini wokwamkelwa. Fumanisa ibali lalo mntu onenceba nesiphelo sakhe esibuhlungu esingafiyo kwisityhilelo sikaThixo.
clues: Ndinikele umnikelo eNkosini yam, kwaye wamkelwe ngobubele.
Umnikelo womntakwethu walahlwa, kwaye umona wenza intliziyo yakhe yaba mnyama.
Ndathi kuye, 'Ukuba undolulela isandla sakho kum ukuze undibulale, andiyi kusolula isandla sam ukuze ndikubulale; ngenene ndiyamoyika uAllah, iNkosi yehlabathi.'
Ndaba lixhoba lesenzo sokuqala sokubulala emhlabeni.
Igazi lam lakhala, kwaye ndingumfeli-nkolo wokuqala ongenatyala.

trial.label: Uvavanyo/Isiganeko
options: Umnikelo wakhe wamkelwa, nto leyo eyabangela umona womntakwabo nokubulawa kwakhe.
Waphoswa esithandweni somlilo kodwa waphuma engenawo nomkrwelo
Wakha inqanawa enkulu phantsi kolwalathiso lukaThixo
Waginywa yintlanzi enkulu waza wahlala ebumnyameni
trial.answer: Umnikelo wakhe wamkelwa, nto leyo eyabangela umona womntakwabo nokubulawa kwakhe.

outcome.label: Isiphumo
options: Uguqulwe waba ziinkawu ngenxa yokwaphula umthetho

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
